card.name: Numbers and dots before time units
card.fires_on: The number or dot-like multiplication mark just before a time unit such as h, hr or min, as in durations and AUC units. The unit itself has not appeared yet.

modes.label: Duration number before h
modes.description: A digit giving a number of hours in an infusion or time span, right before the letter h.
modes.example: IV over no less than <<2>> h ( 2.4 ) PEDI

modes.label: Dot in AUC units
modes.description: The bullet or middle dot joining a concentration unit to a time unit, as in mg•hr/L or μM•min.

card.writes: It suppresses minute and hour words, so it lowers the chance of a time unit written out in full as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a number or dot is about to be followed by a short time unit like h or min.
